findings.classification: Existing historical 059 queue 3134, independently traced at pinned 95e; not a newly counted finding.
findings.first_contract: An admitted zero reconnect grace in Enrolling or Sealed compares reset Duration::ZERO against zero even if a party member is loaded or loading; the result is Abandoned.
findings.reasoning: For Enrolling/Sealed a present or loading party resets empty_for to zero; zero >= zero, so the source returns Abandoned. The selected caller commits Failed. Awaiting with no party and no loading returns early, before threshold.
findings.conditions_and_limits: Conditional on admitted zero grace and an active terminal check in the named state. This is source reasoning, not evidence that parser/configuration, scheduling, mission outcome, network, or product actually ran. Historical Adler READ-L11-322 describes abandonment as only for empty party; that general characterization is too broad at zero grace, but the original bytes and qualification remain intact. Older native GROUP115 states grace zero may abandon by policy; loaded/loading case and default policy remain specific here.
findings.repair_direction: Decide whether admission forbids zero or zero means immediate abandonment only when actually empty; preserve the allowed loading and reconnect semantics. Validate later, outside this source-only task.

findings.classification: Existing 059 Root Lens3 queue 3128, also related to Adler READ-L11-322 and 774 native GROUP115; current conditional narrowing, not a separate counted issue.
findings.first_contract: Receipt projection appends contact-only owners then sorts and truncates party to 16 while retaining all contacts; a contact whose owner is truncated fails strategic validation, while a truncated party consequence can be lost.
findings.reasoning: A raw accumulated set with more than 16 distinct participant IDs can leave a retained contact without a participant and hit the recipient membership check. Separately, a party row outside the sorted first 16 is omitted from the projected receipt. A canonical TacticalPartyRoster has unique, nonempty, at-most-16 admission, constraining the ordinary captured-roster route.
findings.conditions_and_limits: The necessary state is conditional: this pass did not prove an authorized supported session can accumulate >16 distinct participant/contact owners, or that any normal receipt was rejected or lost. All writers, reconnect membership binding, native transport and transaction paths remain open. This is the same first site as the historical roster bound, not a new occurrence.
findings.repair_direction: Trace authoritative roster through admission and every accumulator writer; enforce a consistent retained identity/capacity boundary or explicitly fail overflow rather than silently losing permitted consequences. Choose policy only after supported membership is established.
